top_choice_rationale: P001 best recognizes a mature, generative account of how collateral constraints and credit frictions amplify macroeconomic fluctuations. Kiyotaki, Moore, and Gertler provide a defensible core for the narrowly framed contribution, whose influence across macro-finance theory, quantitative work, and policy analysis is sustained, though Simon Gilchrist's important role remains an attribution qualification.
recusal_note: No apparent connection to the proposed P001 laureates is disclosed in my profile. I have frequent coauthorship with John Hassler and Per Krusell, fellow members who support P001.
